listing.name: Gundam Versus — gvport (johnnygentoo)
listing.summary: Upstream reports ten minutes of Free Battle with audio and CPU opponents at 60 FPS on one Linux PC. Other offline modes, long sessions, saving and a complete playthrough remain unconfirmed. Busy scenes at 4K run around 55 FPS; upstream says an upscaler is needed for steady 60 FPS. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own North American PS4 CUSA08790 base 1.00 game with update 1.13.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream instructions to merge your own CUSA08790 base 1.00 and update 1.13, run game_check.py, then build and run the game with its GTK launcher. Optional two-player mode runs two game instances; it is separate from original native local multiplayer.

warnings: Upstream reports ten minutes of Free Battle with audio and CPU opponents at 60 FPS on one Linux PC. Other offline modes, long sessions, saving and a complete playthrough remain unconfirmed. Busy scenes at 4K run around 55 FPS; upstream says an upscaler is needed for steady 60 FPS.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
